steps.title: Find a DisMech knowledge gap
steps.action: Type to search; select an exact source question on the same page.
steps.incoming: q, fuzzy mode by default, source=dismech and filters.
steps.outgoing: GapSearchResults / GapRecord with exact source detail and scoped account count; AccountList with original author attribution.
rules: Search text is not a new inquiry. Trending entries disappear while typing.

Trending defaults to explicitly published account counts across users. Workspace scope counts the authenticated owner accounts. Count ties shuffle per new browse with a signed cursor seed preserving that order across pages.
The selected gap lists authorized scientific accounts with pagination; original author attribution does not change when ownership transfers.
Question input and scope selector remain fixed while the paginated gap list scrolls; source order is preserved without editorial selection.

steps.title: Choose mechanism anchors
steps.action: Review up to five mapped EAGGL mechanism chips; edit anchors, not linked DisMech context.
steps.incoming: SelectedGap, manual factors, dismissals and optional mechanism subquery.
steps.outgoing: Suggestions and Mechanism records with DAPPER Mechanism, native CFDE ID and catalog File.
rules: Search existing EAGGL label embeddings; join the populated exact-trait/factor-number CFDE crosswalk before selecting five. Ignore label/gene differences.
Five total, maximum cosine across linked mechanisms, deterministic native-ID deduplication; fewer if needed. At least one resolved cfde-inc-v2 anchor is required.
Existing ranked GeneSet links resolve through aliases to DAPPER objects. Missing summary links do not disable a mapped factor.

steps.title: Continue and save
steps.action: Choose ORCID, Google or anonymous at submit; preserve selection and autosave.
steps.incoming: Trusted session, Composer, expected_version and Idempotency-Key.
rules: Local edits before session; no credentials stored in research data.
Composer accepts no free-text inquiry or editable linked DisMech list.

steps.title: Submit saved gap analysis
steps.action: Freeze the confirmed draft and queue analysis.
steps.incoming: AnalysisJobInput: kind=analysis, draft ID/version, bounded budgets.
rules: Freeze saved source/mapping runs and resolved native CFDE IDs; later mapping updates do not retarget this request.
Question collapses upward with chips retained.
worker: Resolve frozen DisMech context; four same-seed CFDE connections plus contextual edges and BioIndex queries.
Build, validate and freeze evidence package with exact source artifacts.
Fresh verified DAPPER clone, Claude Code in Box, selected Proto-OKN tools.
Trusted assembly, minting, final lint plus grounding/ledger/ownership checks.

steps.title: Prepare evidence and observe research
steps.action: Evidence preparation followed by public agent/tool activity; Stop stays available.
steps.outgoing: JobEvent.detail with counts/call state/artifacts; EvidencePackageResult for inspection.
rules: One active loading state; no private reasoning.
Package is the schema-current captured input; account fixture is separately authored, not its accepted agent output.
Completed activity compresses into Gap analysis complete.

steps.title: Read the scientific account
steps.action: Read closing remarks; open associated claims on demand.
steps.incoming: Exact account/claim/GeneSet/object ID and optional payload/traversal bounds.
steps.outgoing: DAPPER document, payload checksums, coverage, artifacts and research_statement state.
rules: Conclusions and Research statement are divider tabs.
Claims open inline; no auto-opened first claim. Dedicated claim page has Assessment, Proposition, Evidence and Provenance tabs.
Partial provenance and unavailable downloads remain explicit.

Accounts remain private until the owner publishes a frozen snapshot with an optimistic version and idempotency key. Later accepted statements require an explicit publication update; unpublishing revokes public access. Public readers cannot access job telemetry or research writes.

steps.title: Generate the cited statement automatically
steps.action: Each accepted account independently queues a paragraph; explicit endpoint supports retry/alternate focus.
steps.incoming: Saved account payload, citation revisions, settings and skill version.
steps.outgoing: Paragraph Job; account remains usable independently.
rules: Unique outbox key prevents duplicate automatic work.
No fresh KG research or invented claims.
worker: Backend assembles citation occurrences and validates exact registry revisions/code-point spans.

steps.title: Follow paragraph generation
steps.action: Show pending/failed/ready research statement without blocking conclusions.
steps.outgoing: ParagraphResult with account and Paragraph IDs.
rules: Shared events/cancel apply to both job kinds.
Paragraph failure does not change analysis success.

steps.title: Read the research statement
steps.action: Render Paragraph text, markers and complete references.
steps.incoming: Exact Paragraph ID and payload observation.
rules: Offsets are Unicode code points, not UTF-16 indices.
Do not substitute latest registry revision when a pin is missing.

steps.title: Copy or download
steps.action: Copy hyperlinked rich text for Word, or download Markdown, LaTeX and BibTeX.
steps.outgoing: ParagraphExport or CitationRendering and native citation formats.
rules: LaTeX includes cite commands; remind users to download references.bib.
Exports share exact Paragraph and registry pins. Rendering does not launch an agent.

support.title: Registered or anonymous ownership
support.action: Gateway establishes trusted session and resolves a stable application UUID.
support.outgoing: Me with principal_kind and optional workspace expiry.
rules: Browser OAuth/bootstrap and service provisioning are separately specified in docs/gateway-contract.md.
No bearer is not anonymous write permission.

support.title: Your gaps and scientific accounts
support.incoming: Trusted owner session, exact gap filters and pagination.
support.outgoing: Exploration/account summaries; saved drafts and immutable request/job history.
rules: Before-session visits remain local; record after trusted bootstrap.
Anonymous recovery requires session possession. Verified sign-in preserves durable access and original authorship.

support.title: Stop or recover
support.action: Request cancellation or recover from stale save/event cursor.
support.incoming: Owned job ID or current cursor/version.
rules: Stopping is not stopped; committed results win cancellation races.
Browser disconnect does not cancel. Resume with monotonic event IDs.
